exterior.facadeStyle: Bliss & Faville, 1904, Beaux-Arts / Renaissance Revival. Grey-buff stone; ground floor deeply rusticated (continuous horizontal channel joints), second floor round-arched windows with carved cartouche/foliate keystones, upper floors flat with quoined window surrounds. Ground-floor storefront openings are tall rectangles (~3.6 m wide x ~4.3 m tall, est.) with bronze/brass-toned frames; ground-floor storey ~5.8 m to the string course (est.).

order_S_to_N: display window with 'Nintendo SAN FRANCISCO' red panel inside

signage.sizeNote: height 42 in (1.07 m) per planning permit; width est. from logo aspect ratio in photos (~2.2:1)

no corner-mounted sign; the corner pier is plain rusticated stone

windowGraphics.description: Full-height translucent vinyl 'parade' of Nintendo mascots marching toward each entrance on every Powell and Geary window (Mario, Luigi, Peach, Toad, Yoshi, Donkey Kong, Link, Isabelle, Inkling Girl, Pikmin, Kirby, Pikachu etc.). Same key art is used on the Nintendo SAN FRANCISCO exclusive merch line and on the 2025 Muni cable-car ad panels ('OPEN NOW 331 POWELL STREET'). Interior displays and life-size statues visible through the glass.

awning.description: The building's existing flat red/burgundy canvas awnings (approx 3.6 m wide x 1.2 m projection, underside ~3.0 m) are retained over every ground-floor bay; Nintendo added under-awning lighting only. Not a Nintendo-branded canopy. Second-floor windows carry Bourbon Steak's burgundy dome (bell) awnings.

lighting.description: Internally illuminated fascia logos; new downlights fitted to the existing awnings (per 2024 permit); Westin globe lamp standards on the Powell sidewalk; strong interior spill through the character windows at night.

exterior.streetContext: Powell St cable-car tracks directly in front (Powell-Mason & Powell-Hyde); Geary St has red-painted transit lanes; brick-paved sidewalk on Powell; 2 street trees in planters on the Powell frontage.

interior.frame: Local axes: +X = north along Powell (interior wall behind Victoria's Secret), +Y = west along Geary; store is entered from the east (Powell) and south (Geary). Footprint est. ~21 m (E-W) x ~24 m (N-S) per floor (~500 m2 each); Powell frontage is only the southern ~14 m of the east side.

items: 2025-06-04/05: Nintendo Switch 2 launch event (sales from 9 pm June 4); Switch 2 demo kiosks (Mario Kart World) added; Switch 2 stocked since.
2025-09-20/21: Mario meet-and-greet for Super Mario Bros. 40th anniversary (line past the Switch kiosks).
2026-02/03: Mario Tennis Fever demo on kiosks; 2026-03-10 MAR10 Day Mario appearance 4-7 pm; 2026-03-14 Mario Tennis Fever doubles tournament (16 teams, Warp Pipe Pass).
2026-03: Super Mario Bros. Wonder + Meetup in Bellabel Park demo on Switch 2 kiosks (NA stores).
2026-07-23: Splatoon Raiders launch event with in-store missions ('Combine the Gadgets', 'Target Salmonids'), demos, gift with purchase.
No report found of any physical re-zoning, new statues or renovation between opening and 2026-09-01; assume layout unchanged.
